name: deriving-a-requalification-gap
description: Use when an office, curriculum, assessment law, protected context, jurisdiction, model, harness, or agent construction changes and prior qualification must be compared with a successor baseline without rewriting history.
preconditions: any prior qualification belongs to the source baseline
the comparison preserves exact candidate layers
postconditions: one RequalificationGap names added and removed competencies and changed office facts
jurisdiction or protected-context change forces full requalification
otherwise only the witnessed gap is formed
